title: Audit live capability-aware frontier projection with repo-only evidence
mission: Independently verify, using only durable repository/live projection evidence, that the capability-aware frontier now reports total clean work separately from generic-compatible work and bounded specialized browser/mobile/host/dispatch buckets. Confirm unknown capability stays unknown rather than being silently treated as absent. This is a read-only/static verification lane: do not require a representative JavaScript browser and do not alter claim authority, candidate ordering, or production /w.
definition_of_done: Read the current gh-pages live/allocator.json projection and record clean_frontier_total, generic_compatible_clean_frontier and capability_pressure buckets with exact source SHA/time.
Trace those published fields to the central allocator/compiler source or regression fixture without reading worker-specific preclaim history.
Verify specialized browser/mobile/host candidates are excluded from the generic-compatible count while unknown capability remains represented as unknown.
Verify no claim/PIN authority, three-attempt limit, deterministic POOL sharding or specialized candidate visibility is changed by the projection.
Return concrete evidence and any discrepancy as a bounded bug/successor; do not infer Current, Human Accepted, Served or /w promotion.
